title: WatchDog Pipeline Layout
description: Optional shareable graph layout stored beside a pipeline's Mermaid and metadata files. This file affects presentation only and is never used for pipeline execution.

nodes.description: Supported value: object mapping Mermaid node IDs to graph positions. Default: an empty object, which uses WatchDog's automatic graph layout for every node. IDs must exist in the adjacent pipeline metadata file.
nodes.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

An object mapping Mermaid node IDs to graph positions. IDs must exist in the adjacent pipeline metadata file.

**Default:** `{}`, which uses WatchDog's automatic graph layout for every node.

propertyNames.description: A node ID declared by the adjacent Mermaid and metadata files.

nodePosition.title: Graph node position
nodePosition.description: The node's top-left position in graph coordinates. Coordinates are rounded to integers when saved.

x.description: Supported value: signed integer horizontal graph coordinate in pixels. Required; there is no implicit default.
x.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

Signed integer horizontal graph coordinate in pixels.

**Required:** yes; there is no implicit default.

y.description: Supported value: signed integer vertical graph coordinate in pixels. Required; there is no implicit default.
y.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

Signed integer vertical graph coordinate in pixels.

**Required:** yes; there is no implicit default.
